name: WiFi CSI and RSS Presence/Movement
summary: Long-form antenna-wise CSI and RSS collection with annotations for detecting human presence and movement.

settings.scenario: Ambient presence and movement monitoring in rooms G19, G21, 260, and 128a

standardization.notes: Presence and movement use the 100 Hz time rule. Keep 30 subcarriers, 1 Tx, and 3 Rx; output is [T, S, Tx, Rx] per sample.
